data.long_meaning: The name Haadiyah is derived from the Arabic word 'haadiya' meaning 'gift', 'present'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes generosity, kindness, and the act of giving. It is a name often given to girls in the Muslim world as a reminder of the blessings and gifts bestowed upon them. The name Haadiyah carries the meaning “Gift, Present” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haadiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, present and live with faith, good character and purpose.
